name: Bistro Elan
note: California-French bistro near California Avenue serving seasonal dishes and wine. It originally opened on California Avenue in 1995 and moved to its Birch Street space in 2011; its current website lists it open at 2363 Birch St.

name: Sun of Wolf
note: Sun of Wolf opened to the public on June 27, 2018, at 406 South California Avenue, serving modern Mexican plates and cocktails. It remains open on California Avenue next to Palo Alto Sol.

name: BMO
note: BMO bank branch, formerly a Bank of the West branch. It took the BMO name after BMO bought Bank of the West in 2023.

name: Valero
note: A Valero gas station operates at 1963 El Camino Real. A January 2008 Palo Alto Online report already identifies the station at this address as Valero, the earliest year found for the Valero name here.

name: Rara
note: Palo Alto's first Nepalese restaurant, which soft-opened in late 2023 and officially opened in November 2023.

name: Homma’s Brown Rice Sushi
note: Masakazu Homma's small sushi shop served only brown-rice sushi for about 30 years. It closed on Aug. 31, 2016 when he retired.

name: Palo Alto Sol
note: Family-run Mexican restaurant serving Puebla-style food, opened around 1992 by Hector and Helena Sol. In 2016 the family also took over the space next door at 406 California Ave.

name: Ramen Kowa
note: Japanese ramen restaurant that opened in November 2020, during the pandemic, and also serves karaage and curry. Still open today.

name: Cafe Pro Bono
note: Italian restaurant on Birch Street near California Avenue, opened in 1988 by chef Ambjorn Lindskog according to the Palo Alto Weekly. It was still operating in the 2020s.

name: Sekoya
note: Restaurant and bar serving California-inspired small plates and cocktails. It officially opened on August 15, 2023, and was still open in 2026.

name: Vitality Bowls
note: Superfood cafe serving acai bowls, smoothies and juices, which opened in July 2015 in the former Cho's dim sum space.

name: Zareen's
note: Pakistani and Indian restaurant that opened on October 7, 2016 in the former Pizza Studio space, as the second location of a Mountain View restaurant. It later expanded into the former Starbucks space next door and is still open.

name: Free Will Baptist Church
note: Open today (place of worship). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Common Ground
note: Organic garden supply store and education center that sold gardening products and taught classes. Founded in Palo Alto in 1972 at 225 El Camino Real, it moved here in 2001 and closed on October 11, 2014.

name: ZombieRunner Coffee
note: Coffee shop that moved here in 2020 from its earlier California Avenue spot in an old movie theater building. That spot opened in 2008 as a combined running store and cafe.

name: Kali Greek Kitchen
note: Fast-casual Greek restaurant that opened in June 2017. Its space had been empty for about three years after Uzumaki Sushi closed.

name: Anatolian Kitchen
note: Kurdish and Turkish restaurant that moved into the former Port of Peri Peri space and planned to reopen here in December 2022. Its earlier Birch Street location closed in 2021.

name: Gamelandia
note: Tabletop game store and play space that soft-opened in October 2022 and held its grand opening that November.

name: Joanie's Cafe
note: Breakfast and lunch cafe that moved here in 2011 from 447 California Ave, a few doors away, where Pastis Bistro then opened. It is still open today.

name: Mediterranean Wraps
note: Counter-service Mediterranean restaurant that moved here from a tiny space two doors away at 425 California Ave. The move was planned in 2006 and reported done by late 2007; it is still open.

name: Vin Vino Wine
note: Wine shop with a daily tasting bar that moved here around 1989 from its first location on Cambridge Avenue, where it opened in 1985. New owners bought it in 2018 and kept the name.

name: Leaf & Petal
note: Women's clothing boutique, in business since 1976. A 2010 report said it had been on California Avenue for 30 years, so it arrived around 1980, and it is still open.

name: Izzy's Brooklyn Bagels
note: Open today (restaurant). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Technology Credit Union
note: Credit union branch that held its grand opening on October 1, 2011, and is still open today.

name: Social Salon
note: Hair salon known for hair extensions, blonding and haircuts, open today. The year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Pop Tea Bar
note: Milk-tea and boba shop that opened in June 2015 in the space Beans n' Bites had used. It is still open.

name: Salon 454
note: Open today (hairdresser). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: California Barber Shop
note: Barber shop on Cambridge Ave, open at least since 2020, when local news named it among the Palo Alto barbershops briefly reopened during the pandemic. It is still open, and its actual opening year may be earlier.

name: Privado Hair Design
note: Open today (hairdresser). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Caffe Riace
note: Italian restaurant serving Sicilian cuisine on the ground floor of an apartment building at Sheridan Avenue, just off California Avenue. It opened in 1997 and is still open.

name: Julian Chase Hair Design
note: Hair salon on Birch Street near California Avenue, open since about late 1996 or 1997 and still open today. Its owner named it after his two children.

name: Naschmarkt
note: Austrian restaurant just off California Avenue, in the space once used by Anatolian Kitchen. It opened on May 17, 2022, and is still open.

name: Cambridge Optometry
note: Full-service eye care practice that moved to the corner of Birch St and Cambridge Ave around 2024, after about fifteen years down the street at 250 Cambridge Ave. Still open.

name: Jacuzzi
note: Open today (swimming pool). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Roy's Cleaners
note: Open today (dry cleaning). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Radhika Beauty Salon
note: Beauty salon offering threading, facials, henna and bridal makeup, open today. It was operating by late 2022, when the Stanford Daily described it; the exact opening year isn't known.

name: Odori Sushi
note: Open today (restaurant). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Designer's Tailoring
note: Open today (dry cleaning). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: PIP Printing
note: A print and document services shop founded in 1974, which won a top-25 sales award from the PIP chain in 2007. It is still open today.

name: Village Flower Shop
note: Open today (florist). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: First Republic Bank
note: First Republic Bank branch near El Camino Real and Cambridge Avenue, established in May 2002. First Republic was acquired by JPMorgan Chase in 2023.

name: Spoke & Weal
note: Hair salon known for dry cuts that officially opened on April 1, 2017, in the former Legar Salon space. It was the chain's fourth location after San Francisco, New York and Chicago.

name: California Paint Company
note: Paint store, formerly known as California Paint and Wallpaper, open at this address by the mid-1980s, when it spread into two storefronts. It went back to a single storefront in 2007 and is still open.

name: La Jolie Nail Spa
note: A nail salon that opened around 2007 in space California Paint and Wallpaper had given up next door. Local press reported it as coming soon in June 2007, and it is still open.

name: Campus Barber Shop
note: Barber shop on California Avenue, open at least since 2011, when a local neighborhood haircut guide recommended it at this address. It is still listed here today, and it may have opened earlier.

name: Christian Science Reading Room
note: Public reading room and bookstore run by First Church of Christ, Scientist, Palo Alto. A Spring 2009 visitors guide lists it at this address; it may have opened earlier.

name: Palo Alto Eyeworks
note: Optician on California Ave. The shop says it has served Palo Alto since 1992, and a 2009 visitors guide lists it at this address.

name: Hairshaper's Club
note: Open today (hairdresser). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Namaste
note: Indian restaurant, part of a small regional chain that began in Monterey. Palo Alto Weekly readers named it the best new food or drink spot in 2023, and it is still open.

name: La Bohème
note: French bistro from the owner of Pastis that opened in November 2015 in the former Chez Franc hot dog space. It is still open.

name: California Avenue Optometry
note: Open today (optician). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: The Cobblery
note: Family-run shoe repair shop that also sells footwear, dating to 1940 and earlier known as Paul's European Cobblery. It started in a smaller storefront nearby on the street before settling at 410 California Ave.

name: Omomi
note: Open today (beauty). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Hair Studio

name: Imperial Treasure
note: Chinese restaurant that opened in late 2023 in the Palo Alto Central building, in the space that used to be Peking Duck.

name: Protégé
note: Restaurant opened in March 2018 by a chef and a master sommelier who had both worked at the French Laundry. It earned a Michelin star in November 2018, about nine months after opening.

name: Fambrini's Cafe
note: Daytime cafe serving sandwiches, salads and other breakfast and lunch fare, founded in the early 1990s at 2600 El Camino Real next door. It moved to a ground-floor space with a patio here and reopened on July 26, 2017.

name: Topi
note: Topi Cakes is a cake shop selling daily treats and custom cakes, and it also runs cake-making classes. It opened on October 8, 2025, in the space Shekoh Confections used to occupy.

name: Fast Repair
note: Open today (electronics). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Serenity Nails
note: Nail salon offering manicure, pedicure and waxing services. The salon says it held its grand opening in 2022.

name: Palo Alto Fitness Club
note: Private personal-training studio, also known as Palo Alto Fit, which moved here from Portage Ave after its owners bought 310-320 California Ave in 2023. It took over the space of the Performance Gaines gym and opened here around 2025.

name: Bar Underdog
note: Cocktail and wine bar from the team behind the Michelin-starred Protégé, in the former Calave wine bar space. It held its grand opening on September 18, 2025.

name: iTalico
note: Italian restaurant from the owners of nearby Terún, opened in July 2016. It took over the space of the short-lived Fire, Oak & Barley.

name: Raw Smoke Shop
note: Tobacco shop on California Avenue next to Pilates V. Local news reported in April 2019 that its storefront was ready to open after its permit was finalized that March, and it is still open today.

name: Real Produce International Market
note: International grocery store at College Terrace Centre that opened in late December 2020. It was the third grocer in the space, after College Terrace Market and Khoury's Market.

name: Xfinity
note: Open today (telecommunication). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Backyard Brew
note: Outdoor courtyard coffee cafe that officially opened in early 2017 in the former Toscano Garden decor shop space. It added a food menu in 2019 and was temporarily closed by the city in February 2025 over permit violations.

name: Palo Alto Shell
note: Shell gas station and auto repair shop on El Camino Real. Its own dated posts show it open at this address by 2014, and it is still open today.

name: Shell
note: Open today (convenience). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: MJ Sushi
note: MJ Sushi is a sushi restaurant known for late-night hours. It opened in early 2023 in the space that Pizz'a Chicago used to occupy.

name: Daigo
note: Second location of a San Francisco sushi restaurant, serving Japanese appetizers, nigiri, sashimi and omakase. It opened in spring 2019 in the former Homma's Brown Rice Sushi space and is still listed at this address.

name: Victoria Ballet
note: Classical ballet school for children and adults that opened its Palo Alto studio on California Avenue in January 2023. It is still open.

name: Massage Therapy Center
note: Founded in 1971 on Everett Avenue as The Massage Center, it moved to California Avenue in 1981 as Body Therapy Center. It took the Massage Therapy Center name in 2006 and still offers therapeutic massage here.

name: The Cosmetic Collective
note: Boutique spa offering facials, skin treatments, lashes, brows and spray tanning. It was open by late 2024 and is still operating.

name: Wow Tea

name: Wells Fargo

name: Chipotle
